name: Rabbit Finance
rootCause: Medium user Anonymous Dev published an article stating that there are a large number of loopholes in the BSC ecological Rabbit Finance code, which may be suspected of running away. The vulnerabilities include: 1. The total supply of tokens RABBIT is not the hard cap of 203,000,000 as the team claims; 2. The owner of Rabbit's FairLaunch can issue unlimited RABBIT tokens at any time; 3. 100% of the positions can be liquidated at any time and funds It can be stolen at any time, and there is no maximum limit on the configurable protocol parameters; 4. All funds on the platform may be stolen, and Rabbit’s EOA account can be upgraded to execute the contract at any time.…
